breaking_news.headline: The war with Iran is making oil changes pricier. And a deal won't solve it
breaking_news.summary: The U.S. may be the world's biggest producer of crude oil, but that's not the case for motor oil. The cost of lubricants is soaring, and even a tentative deal to end the war won't solve the problem.

breaking_news.headline: Shipping exec says industry needs assurances Strait of Hormuz will be safe
breaking_news.summary: NPR's Ailsa Chang talks with Jakob Larsen, chief safety and security officer at BIMCO, the global shipping association, about what it might mean to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

breaking_news.headline: Federal Reserve holds interest rates steady and hints at rate hike later this year
breaking_news.summary: The Federal Reserve left its benchmark interest rates unchanged Wednesday, and signaled its next move could be a rate increase. It's the first rate decision under the new Fed chairman, Kevin Warsh.

breaking_news.headline: With Iran deal, Trump told ships to 'start your engines.' That's not happening yet
breaking_news.summary: Iran's control of the Strait of Hormuz inflicted global pain during the months-long conflict with the U.S. and Israel. A tentative deal is in place, but questions remain about the key waterway.

breaking_news.headline: Here's how much the Iran war cost -- and how its effects will linger
breaking_news.summary: More than three months after the U.S. and Israel launched their war on Iran, the costs and aftereffects are felt around the world.

breaking_news.headline: Poll: Most Americans have the summer blues about Trump and the economy
breaking_news.summary: A new NPR/PBS News/Marist poll finds a record low share of Americans approve of President Trump's job performance and his handling of the economy heading into the summer before a key midterm election.

breaking_news.headline: Here is how SpaceX could turn up in your current investments
breaking_news.summary: SpaceX stock hit the market last week. Here's how it could turn up in your retirement or investment portfolio.

breaking_news.headline: Alan Greenspan, the legendary former Federal Reserve chair, dies
breaking_news.summary: During his chairmanship, Greenspan was celebrated as possibly the best central banker in history. But later, his reputation was tarnished by the worst financial crisis since the Great Depression.

breaking_news.headline: Twins marry twins in joyous Nigerian joint wedding
breaking_news.summary: Brothers Taiwo and Kehinde Oguntoye speak to the BBC after getting hitched to twin sisters.

breaking_news.headline: WhatsApp to be led by Indian start-up founder as Will Cathcart steps back
breaking_news.summary: WhatsApp's leadership shake-up comes as Meta looks to strengthen its app's already booming presence in India.

breaking_news.headline: Schools close as more than half of France under red heat alerts
breaking_news.summary: The health minister warns many citizens "will suffer", with temperatures set to peak on Monday.

breaking_news.headline: Russian troop build-up threatens city seen as key to seizing Ukraine's Donbas
breaking_news.summary: If Kostyantynivka falls, Russian forces would be able push towards Ukraine's last remaining strongholds in the east.

breaking_news.headline: Largest ever cocaine bust in Australia after police raid underground bunker
breaking_news.summary: Police seized 2.7 tonnes of cocaine worth an estimated A$816m after searching a property in western Sydney.

breaking_news.headline: Myanmar army killed over 700 civilians in six months, UN says
breaking_news.summary: The new UN report says the 702 civilian deaths over six months last year included 153 children.

breaking_news.headline: At least 13 killed and dozens injured after Qatar gas explosion
breaking_news.summary: The city's main liquified natural gas (LNG) processing site suffered a "technical accident" in the Ras Laffan industrial zone.

breaking_news.headline: Vance says Iran will allow nuclear inspectors back into the country
breaking_news.summary: The US vice-president says a great deal of progress has been made after the first round of talks between the US and Iran.

breaking_news.headline: Wowcher sorry for 'unacceptable' crocodile attack email
breaking_news.summary: The firm's marketing email appeared to reference an incident involving a toddler at a zoo.

breaking_news.headline: 'I couldn't sleep when I heard the last bank would close'
breaking_news.summary: When 84-year-old Maggie Dodd discovered that the last remaining bank in Lochgilphead was closing, she began to panic.

breaking_news.headline: Is Germany looking again at coal-powered electricity?
breaking_news.summary: It had planned to abandon the fuel, but the higher cost of natural gas may make it think again.

breaking_news.headline: Toy Story 5 scores record opening weekend for franchise
breaking_news.summary: The film's opening is a return to form for Disney and Pixar after facing notable challenges in recent years.
